standard_prerequisites.name: The degeneration of the local cohomology spectral sequence of another chapter to short exact sequences
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 1236 and attributed to the cited chapter's lemma (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the short exact sequences that the proof assembles into the displayed sequence.

core_obligations: Produce the short exact sequences: for every closed subset Z contained in the subset and every element f with the required condition on V(f), the spectral sequence referenced by the author degenerates to give short exact sequences relating the local cohomology with support in the intersection to the f-torsion of the local cohomology with support in Z (proof lines 1234-1240)

Pass to the colimit: taking the filtered colimit of those sequences over the pairs (Z, f) and using the description of the functor along the bigger subset as a colimit gives the left-hand map of the displayed sequence (proof lines 1240-1250)

Identify the remaining terms: the proof checks that the middle and right-hand terms of the displayed sequence are the local cohomology along the two subsets and a direct sum over the minimal primes of the local cohomology of the localizations (proof lines 1250-1258)

Exactness at the end: for an element of the middle term mapping to zero, the proof chooses closed subsets and an element f realising the condition and concludes, which gives exactness of the displayed sequence (proof lines 1258-1263)
proof_roadmap: 对每个 Z ⊂ T 与满足 V(f) ∩ Z ⊂ T' 的 f，用被引章的局部对偶谱序列退化得到短正合列 0 → H^1_f(H^{i-1}_Z(M)) → H^i_{Z ∩ V(f)}(M) → H^0_f(H^i_Z(M)) → 0。
对这些 (Z, f) 取滤过余极限（左侧用本卡上下文里的 colim 描述），再把中项与右项分别认成 H^i_{T'}(M)、H^i_T(M) 与极小素位处的局部上同调直和；最后用取 Z' ⊂ Z 与 f 使 V(f) ∩ Z = Z' 的办法验证末端正合性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the exact sequence comparing local cohomology along a specialization-stable subset with the local cohomology along the subset of its nonminimal points (author lemma at source lines 1216-1232, label lemma-filter-local-cohomology), with an explicit colimit term built from the f-torsion of the local cohomology with support in closed subsets. The proof (source lines 1234-1263) is a genuine colimit argument: it degenerates a spectral sequence of another chapter into short exact sequences (proof lines 1234-1240), passes to the filtered colimit over the pairs (Z, f) using the description of the functor supplied by the author's adjoint lemma, and then verifies exactness at the end by producing closed subsets and an element witnessing the required condition (proof lines 1258-1263). The colimit passage and the final exactness check are the substance. H2.
